verdict.rationale: E2B's filesystem API (files.read/write, commands.run) lets users pull files out of a sandbox, and the project is open-source with a self-hosting guide, reducing lock-in, but there is no documented bulk 'export all your data' feature, no account/data portability tooling, and no explicit open-format export guarantee beyond raw filesystem access.  missing for 10: dedicated data export/backup mechanism, explicit open-format guarantee, evidence of exporting sandbox state/metrics/logs in bulk, independent confirmation of self-hosting migration in practice.
